text_block_list.text:
The day of Valentine's.
With many students exchanging chocolates,
a festive, cheerful mood drifted through the academy.
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yo, Trainy! Pardon the intrusion!
choice_data_list: What's wrong, all of a sudden?
What's wrong, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'what's going on'?! Today's only about
one thing and one thing only!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And so, here! Chocolates.
Thanks for everything as always, Trainee-boy!

Opening the package right away revealed a neat line-up
of beautiful chocolates in various shapes.

Just what brand could this be from?
I was so curious that I decided to ask—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah, I made this myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's a hit with the dorm girls too, and doing it every year
seems to have really sharpened my skills.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I had a hard time shaping the roses last year,
but this year, I managed to make them look pretty decent.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Look at this! ...It's not just a portrait, it's portrait chocolates of you and me!

The chocolate Hishi Amazon pointed to
was indeed shaped like a familiar face...!
choice_data_list: They look just like each other!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Right?
I used a bunch of tiny chisels to make it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fuji and the others told me
they didn't even realize I was making chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, none of that really matters anyway!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I guarantee the taste!
Eat up whenever you're feeling tired.

All in all, after properly taking photos,
we savored the chocolates.

Opening the package right away revealed
a gâteau au chocolat served with fresh whipped cream.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Give it a taste, Trainy!

Taking a bite, a moist texture spreads
throughout the mouth. Beneath it lies a layer
packed with crunchy walnuts.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Heheh.
That's great!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it's Big Sis Hishiama's special low-carb,
low-fat, ultra-healthy gâteau au chocolat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Tofu instead of whipped cream, Lakanto instead of sugar,
and caramelized walnuts with maple syrup, please."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Chocolates are unexpectedly high in calories, after all.
I figured I might as well make it healthy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, either way, I'm relieved to hear you say it's delicious. Phew~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Nah... hearing you say it was delicious just made me wonder why I felt so relieved, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I'd just think, "Eat as much as you want!"
Though right now...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...?
Hmm~? What's this?!

All in all...
It seems she put in a lot of trial and error.
It warms my heart.
choice_data_list: Let's eat together, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way, of course
I made it for you, Trainer-dude.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
W-What's the matter?
You're being awfully pushy today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, something like this isn't bad once in a while.
How about I brew some coffee?"
Afterward, I brewed some hot coffee, and we indulged in an elegant teatime together.
